title: 第16章 剑楼第17章 无名
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 这是一位十分年轻的男子，模样与沈正峰有七分相似。
他衣着不菲，面色带着些许苍白，一双眸子中尽是漠然。
纵使身上带着伤，但他的气息，却丝毫不弱于李沐颜。
“沈长瑞。”
沈长青眉头一挑，认出了来人正是他那位天才弟弟。
李沐颜微微颔首，面色古井无波。
“瑞儿，你来的正好。”
秦荷像是一下子找到了主心骨，连忙拉着沈长瑞的手道：“你爹被人打伤了，这件事不能就这么算了！”
沈长瑞眼神始终漠然，他看了一眼沈正峰，最后又看了看沈长青，道：“一百二十枚灵石而已，爹，娘，给他吧。”
秦荷微微张了张嘴，沈正峰摇摇头，也没有再多说，抬手便扔过去了一个装满灵石的玉盒。
沈长青接过玉盒，打开一看，一股浓郁的灵气顿时扑面而来，他仔细清点一番，确认无误后，这才将玉盒收起。
沈正峰冷声道：“灵石到手就滚吧。”
沈长青却是不动，只是侧眸向李沐颜询问道：“对了，娘子，化丹境一年修行所需的资源大概是多少灵石啊？”
李沐颜仔细思考了一番，道：“按照学宫的标准来算，差不多两万灵石吧。”
“两万！”
沈长青眼睛猛然一亮，随后便肆无忌惮的打量着不远处的沈正峰三人，道：“娘子，你说到时候沈家能拿出这么多灵石吗？”
李沐颜莞尔一笑，道：“夫君放心，只要签下学宫契书，哪怕他们拿不出一丝一毫的灵石，就是卖房、借高利贷，学宫也会让他们如数偿还的。”
一旁的沈正峰，脸色愈发阴沉起来，而秦荷，则有些惊慌失措。
沈长青哈哈一笑，道：“沈家主可要备好足够的灵石，待我突破至化丹境后再来取。”
“当真是无知者无畏。”
始终冷漠如常的沈长瑞摇了摇头，道：“爹娘，莫要担心，如他这般资质，凭借着好运一次就成功突破至聚灵境的例子学宫的历史上并非没有过，但化丹境，那可不是运气好就能突破的。”
闻言，沈正峰与秦荷脸色这才有所好转，两人皆是讽笑道：“运气再好，但终究也只是个庸才罢了，也敢奢望化丹？”
“即便侥幸突破至聚灵境，但对我沈家而言，你终究只是个累赘罢了，呵呵。”
说罢，他们不再理会沈长青，而是对沈长瑞道：“瑞儿，你快回去休养吧，只要能突破化丹境，便有参加神选的资格了。”
说到神选，沈正峰与秦荷眼中满是希冀与渴望，沈长瑞漠然点头，转身离开。
“累赘吗。”
沈长青哂笑一声，不以为意，如今灵石到手，他自然也没有留在此地的必要了，“娘子，我们走吧。”
李沐颜点点头，两人并肩离开……
临江城，外城区，太虚剑观。
剑山山腰的一间静室之内。
“原来想要参加神选得先突破化丹境吗。”
离开沈家后，沈长青向李沐颜询问了关于神选的事，得知这神选乃是事关整个临江府的大事，通过神选的人，不仅能带着家人一起前往净土修行，而且还能得到诸多好处。
这神选乃是三年一度，不限制年龄，但限制修行时间，只有修行不超过三年且修为达到化丹境才能参加。
而下一届神选，距离今日还有一年零几个月。
“错过这次机会，我就没有参加的资格了。”
沈长青沉思起来：“看来得在一年内突破化丹境，不过我拥有天道酬勤，只要有资源，这并不是什么难事。”
“不过现在，先不着急提升修为，在加入镇妖司之前先修炼一下太虚剑诀吧。”
修为是参加神选的资格，战力则是通过神选的条件。
content_en:
This is a very young man who looks very similar to Shen Zhengfeng.
He was well-dressed, his face was a little pale, and his eyes were full of indifference.
Even though he was injured, his aura was no weaker than Li Muyan's.
"Shen Changrui."
Shen Changqing raised his eyebrows and recognized that the person who came was his genius brother.
Li Muyan nodded slightly, her expression as calm as ever.
"Ruier, you came just in time."
Qin He seemed to have found his backbone all of a sudden, and quickly took Shen Changrui's hand and said, "Your father was injured, we can't just let it go!"
Shen Changrui's eyes remained indifferent. He glanced at Shen Zhengfeng, and finally at Shen Changqing, and said, "It's just one hundred and twenty spiritual stones. Father, mother, give them to him."
Qin He opened his mouth slightly, and Shen Zhengfeng shook his head. Without saying anything more, he raised his hand and threw over a jade box filled with spiritual stones.
Shen Changqing took the jade box and opened it. A strong aura suddenly hit his face. He carefully counted it and after confirming that it was correct, he put the jade box away.
Shen Zhengfeng said coldly: "Get out of here once you get the spirit stone."
However, Shen Changqing did not move. He just looked sideways and asked Li Muyan: "By the way, madam, how many spiritual stones are needed for one year of cultivation in the Alchemy Realm?"
Li Muyan thought about it carefully and said, "According to the academy's standards, it's about 20,000 spirit stones."
"Twenty thousand!"
Shen Changqing's eyes suddenly lit up, and then he looked at Shen Zhengfeng and the other three people not far away unscrupulously, and said: "Madam, do you think the Shen family can produce so many spiritual stones by then?"
Li Muyan smiled and said: "Don't worry, husband, as long as they sign the deed of the academy, even if they can't bring out any spiritual stones, even if they sell their houses or borrow loan sharks, the academy will let them repay them in full."
Shen Zhengfeng's face on the side became increasingly gloomy, while Qin He was a little panicked.
Shen Changqing laughed and said: "Master Shen, please prepare enough spirit stones and come back to get them after I break through to the realm of alchemy."
"It is true that the ignorant are fearless."
Shen Changrui, who had always been indifferent as usual, shook his head and said: "Mom and dad, don't worry. With his qualifications, it is not uncommon in the history of the Academy to successfully break through to the Soul Gathering Realm with just good luck, but the Alchemy Realm cannot be broken through with good luck."
Hearing this, Shen Zhengfeng and Qin He's expressions improved. They both said with a sarcastic smile: "No matter how lucky you are, you are just mediocre in the end. How dare you expect to turn into an elixir?"
"Even if you are lucky enough to break through to the Soul Gathering Realm, you will still be nothing more than a burden to our Shen family, haha."
After that, they ignored Shen Changqing and said to Shen Changrui: "Rui'er, go back and recuperate. As long as you can break through the realm of alchemy, you will be qualified to participate in the divine selection."
Speaking of the divine choice, Shen Zhengfeng and Qin He's eyes were full of hope and desire. Shen Changrui nodded indifferently and turned to leave.
"Is it a burden?"
Shen Changqing chuckled and didn't take it seriously. Now that he has the spirit stone, he naturally has no need to stay here. "Madam, let's go."
"Yeah."
Li Muyan nodded, and the two left side by side...
…
Linjiang City, outer city area, Taixu Sword Temple.
In a quiet room on the mountainside of Jian Mountain.
"So if you want to participate in the God's Choice, you have to break through the Alchemy Realm first."
After leaving the Shen family, Shen Changqing asked Li Muyan about the Divine Selection and learned that the Divine Selection was a major matter for the entire Linjiang Mansion. Those who passed the Divine Selection could not only take their families to the Pure Land to practice, but also receive many benefits.
This divine selection is held every three years. There is no age limit, but there is a limit on the training time. Only those who have practiced for no more than three years and have reached the Alchemy Realm can participate.
The next divine selection is still a year and a few months away from today.
"If I miss this opportunity, I will not be eligible to participate."
Shen Changqing pondered: "It seems that I have to break through to the Alchemy Realm within a year, but I have God's reward for my hard work. As long as I have the resources, this is not a difficult task."
"But now, don't worry about improving your cultivation level. Let's practice the Taixu Sword Art before joining the Demon Suppression Division."
Cultivation is the qualification to participate in the divine selection, and combat power is the condition for passing the divine selection.
